text:
June (Community): Quick note 1213 — we just published community-ops-kit v0.2.0 and are running a short Ops + Maintainer Showcase next Fri 3pm PT. RSVP: https://events.redwood.ai/ops-kit-showcase. Please flag any folks who maintain infra adapters. :mega:

Manu (Engineering): Nice! what's new in v0.2.0?

June (Community): Non-breaking. Copy/paste bullets for READMEs:

community-ops-kit v0.2.0
- new: CLI helpers for Dedicated autoscale policies
- new: config templating for multi-cluster deployments
- perf: reduced agent memory by ~15%
- fix: race condition in shutdown hook under high load
- docs: ops-runbook + sample alert rules

Rae (Maintainer): Can I get a short YAML snippet for the autoscale policy to drop into docs and examples?

Manu (Engineering): Adding snippet here:

```yaml
autoscale:
  policy: "cpu-based"
  target_utilization: 0.65
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 10
```

Al (DevRel): For the Showcase I'm reserving 4 demo slots (10min + 5min Q&A). Maintainers can demo autoscale, multi-cluster deploys, or alerting flows. Please attach a screenshot or short gif. I'll post a short announcement when we have assets.

Rae (Maintainer): I'll demo the multi-cluster templating and include a short perf note (cold-start p95 ~220ms on Dedicated-2x). Can Ops provide a screenshot of the Dedicated dashboard?

June (Community): Ops screenshots available on request — include the checkbox on the event signup. We also have an office hour Wed 11am PT to help with demos and release notes.

release-bot: Automated release notice: community-ops-kit v0.2.0 published by @june. Changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-ops-kit/compare/v0.1.3...v0.2.0. CI: all checks passed. :robot_face:

Manu (Engineering): One reminder: if demos exercise multi-cluster, include network notes (peering / ingress) and any required IAM scopes. Ops can help confirm minimal scopes.

June (Community): Thanks team! Drop promo copy here or DM me and I'll push the announcement. Looking forward to the Showcase :rocket:
